readerCopy.body: Something once avoided can become easier to approach when there is a concrete action to take instead of another round of anticipation. When Mars trines Chiron, action and sensitivity reinforce each other, allowing movement to interrupt an old pattern around embarrassment, rejection, weakness, or feeling unprepared. You may find that one practical action gives you better information than another hour spent imagining how difficult the moment could be. The new response does not have to erase the old experience to create a different outcome now.
